observations.text: Predeclared comparison: choose Pathfinder twice, earn the second level through Silverford Shrine, Briarwood and Raven Hill, buy two Rangers via one recruitment and one Militia replacement, then compare Border Watch and Stranded Explorer while keeping Moonstone equipped. The matched Skirmisher branch starts from the identical historical choice; all actual costs, mistakes, wounds and necessary recovery remain recorded. No autoplay after this anchor.

Briarwood opening shows a genuine counter to movement bonuses: the hero has zero reachable cells until a friendly troop vacates a neighboring deployment cell. Clear the Militia before moving the hero; forest still blocks line of sight even though Pathfinder removes movement cost.

At Border Watch, Pathfinder makes the Warden's two-step forest path to the seal reachable in round one. This alone cannot win: the adjacent Pikeman contests control, and the other enemies can approach. Coordinate ranged fire before evaluating the enemy phase.

The first Watch enemy phase disproves any automatic hold from early seal arrival: the enemy Archer and Brigand both enter adjacent cover and contest it. The Warden absorbs only three HP of damage, enabling a second-round rout without spending additional mana.

After the Watch reward, the director attempted an unsupported generic 'keep' choice. The public command rejected it; no game mutation occurred, and the journal remains after resolve_battle. Inspect the actual offered relic ID before accepting it.

Greenwater's last Brigand moves into forest. Direct shots from the northern line are blocked despite Pathfinder; reposition onto the eastern plains instead of paying retaliation with the adjacent Archer or Militia.

Explorer round two: all four neighboring exit cells are screened or reserved, and the surviving Guard/Warden remain two cells from the exit. The hero cannot walk onto the friendly Warden's occupied exit; reachable cells include (-3,0) but exclude (-3,1). Use Swap to transfer the unspent hero onto the exit. Do not Heal the Militia first: even Skirmisher would not restore the hero action required for evacuation. Ten Militia wounds and the three inherited Archer wounds will remain after escape.

The Pathfinder branch reaches its predeclared six-battle endpoint without casualties, retreats, retries or extra recovery turns. Stop immediately after reward acceptance; do not normalize its wounds with an additional rest.

observations.text: Delegated economic_depth_design directs the declared Skirmisher branch from the authenticated historical pending first-skill save. Both earned skill choices will be Skirmisher. Follow the paid Shrine/Briarwood/Raven Hill/Watch/Greenwater/Explorer north itinerary, keep Moonstone equipped, retain mistakes and casualties, no autoplay, no retries or alternative simulated branches. Limit six battle attempts, turn seven and two justified extra recovery turns.

The delegated Skirmisher branch ends after six actual victories, five round-two routs and a round-two Explorer escape, without retries, casualties, autoplay, spell casts, extra recovery turns, or a normalization rest. The two paid Ranger transactions total 100 gold and the Militia replacement consumes one action. Both mandatory end-turns were retained. Final wounds are Hero 4, Militia 12, Archer 2 and Ranger 5 three; Explorer enemies dealt ten damage to the Militia during the single enemy phase. The final Boots choice is taken unequipped; Moonstone remains equipped. Tactical choices were independently directed and differ from the paired Pathfinder pilot, so final damage differences do not isolate a skill-only effect.
